1.translation: to be worth, valid or acceptable
1.meaning: to be worth, valid or acceptable
definition_path: (transitive) to be worth, valid or acceptable

example.text: Ele se valeu de mentiras para ganhar esse prêmio.
example.english: He used lies to win this prize.

example.text: O ator valeu um prémio pelo seu desempenho.
example.english: The actor earned an award for his film.

definition_path: (Brazil, familiar) thanks (expression of gratitude or satisfaction)
